texts.client_setup_guide: 📌 Client setup ⚙️ Configuration files: Open 📥 Download INCY: Open Guides for different clients differ. Find your client in the list and follow the instructions exactly step by step. INCY (recommended) 1. Download the INCY file for your OS. 2. Open INCY. 3. Go to: “Settings” → “Backup” → “Select file”. 4. Select the previously downloaded config from the configuration post. 5. Choose “Replace” and press “Apply”. 6. On the INCY main screen, go again to “Settings” → “Per-app proxy” and select all pro-Russian apps that do not work with VPN. 7. Paste the subscription from our bot. v2RayTun (legacy core, issues possible) 1. Download the v2RayTun file. 2. Open v2RayTun. 3. Go to: “Settings” → “App settings” → “Restore settings”. 4. Select the previously downloaded config from the configuration post. 5. On the v2RayTun main screen, go again to “Settings” → “Routing” and select all pro-Russian apps that do not work with VPN. 6. Paste the subscription from our bot. ℹ️ For help with another client or additional help with INCY and v2RayTun, contact support. ⚠️ Important: We use XRay 26.7.28+ with XHTTP transport and REALITY plugin.
